title: Digital Edition of Filippo Cavriana's Correspondence
notes: The repository Pantagrueliste/CavrianaCorr (live 200) is a digital TEI edition of Filippo Cavriana's late-16th-century correspondence, described as 'Digital Edition of Filippo Cavriana's Correspondence'; licence CC BY 4.0. Matches the collected 2-text collection exactly. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Pantagrueliste (research project on Cavriana correspondence), GitHub-hosted TEI edition
